comparison.objective: Select and insert a PH2 bit into a screwdriver holder; candidate uses a hex bit to unlock, adjust, and relock a damper before testing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve fine bit alignment, but PR performs one 0.05 mm-clearance hex-shank insertion while steadying a tool. Candidate must engage a recessed socket, torque a captive screw, withdraw, rotate the collar, reacquire the relocated socket, and tighten.
comparison.success_condition: PR succeeds with the PH2 bit seated ≥9 mm within tight pose tolerances and both arms retracted. Candidate additionally requires retained setting and two force/travel-safe dynamic cycles.
comparison.reason: There is primitive-level overlap in hexagonal alignment, but the candidate meaningfully extends it into captive fastener manipulation, moving-socket reacquisition, locking, and dynamic commissioning.
